details.description:
The Arduino Uno R3 is a versatile and reliable microcontroller development board based on the ATmega328. It features 14 digital input/output pins, including 6 PWM-capable pins, along with 6 analog input pins for connecting sensors and other electronic components.

The board operates at 5V and supports a recommended external input voltage of 7–12V. It features a 16 MHz clock speed, 32 KB flash memory, 2 KB SRAM, and 1 KB EEPROM. The Uno R3 also provides USB connectivity, a DC power jack, ICSP header, reset button, and onboard indicator LEDs.

With support for UART serial communication, I2C/TWI, and SPI, the Arduino Uno R3 can be used in a wide range of electronics and embedded-system projects. It can be programmed through the Arduino software using the onboard USB connection and comes with a pre-installed bootloader for convenient programming.

This Arduino Uno R3 package includes a USB programming cable, making it ready to connect to a computer and start programming.

details.description:
Arduino Uno R3 SMD CH340G Development Board

The Arduino Uno R3 SMD CH340G is an affordable development board based on the ATmega328 SMD microcontroller. It uses the CH340G USB-to-UART interface for USB connectivity and programming, making it suitable for electronics development, robotics, STEM education, automation, sensor projects, and embedded prototyping.

Unlike the traditional DIP version, this board uses a Surface-Mount Device (SMD) version of the ATmega328. It provides the familiar Arduino Uno pin configuration with 14 digital I/O pins, including 6 PWM outputs, and 6 analog input pins.

The board operates at 5V and has a recommended external input voltage of 7V to 12V. It can be powered through either the DC power jack or USB.

Technical Specifications

Specification Details
Microcontroller ATmega328 (SMD)
USB Interface CH340G
Operating Voltage 5V
Recommended Input Voltage 7V - 12V
Input Voltage Limit 6V - 20V
Digital I/O Pins 14 (6 provide PWM output)
PWM Digital I/O Pins 6
Analog Input Pins 6
DC Current per I/O Pin 40 mA
DC Current for 3.3V Pin 50 mA
Clock Speed 16 MHz
SRAM 2 KB
EEPROM 1 KB
Flash Memory 32 KB (0.5 KB used by bootloader)
Power Supply Options DC Jack or USB
On-Board LEDs On/Off, L (Pin 13), TX, RX
Operating Temperature -40°C to +90°C
Dimensions 75 × 54 × 12 mm
Weight 26 g
Shipment Weight 0.16 kg
Shipment Dimensions 12 × 8 × 4 cm

Key Features

  • ATmega328 SMD microcontroller
  • CH340G USB-to-UART interface
  • 14 digital input/output pins
  • 6 PWM output pins
  • 6 analog input pins
  • 16 MHz clock speed
  • 32 KB Flash memory
  • 2 KB SRAM and 1 KB EEPROM
  • On-board Power, Pin 13, RX and TX LEDs
  • USB and DC Jack power options
  • Compact SMD-based design

Power

The Arduino Uno R3 SMD can be powered through the USB connection or external DC power jack. The recommended input voltage is 7V to 12V.

  • Operating Voltage: 5V
  • Recommended Input: 7V - 12V
  • Input Voltage Limit: 6V - 20V
  • Power Options: DC Jack or USB
  • 3.3V Pin Current: 50 mA

Avoid unnecessarily high input voltage through the barrel jack, as higher voltage increases heat dissipation in the onboard regulator.

Memory

The ATmega328 provides sufficient memory for Arduino-based electronics, robotics, automation, and embedded projects.

  • Flash Memory: 32 KB
  • Bootloader: 0.5 KB
  • SRAM: 2 KB
  • EEPROM: 1 KB

Input and Output

The board provides 14 digital I/O pins and 6 analog inputs for connecting sensors, LEDs, displays, switches, motors, modules, and other electronic components.

  • Digital I/O: 14 pins
  • PWM: 6 pins
  • Analog Inputs: 6 pins
  • Maximum I/O Current: 40 mA per pin

USB Interface & Programming

This version uses the CH340G USB-to-UART converter instead of the ATmega16U2 interface used on the standard Arduino Uno R3. It provides USB connectivity for programming and serial communication.

Depending on the operating system, a compatible CH340/CH341 driver may be required so that the board can be detected as a virtual COM port.

Applications

  • Sensor grid prototyping
  • Embedded automation projects
  • Data logging using SPI or I2C peripherals
  • Smart home relay control prototypes
  • Motor speed regulation
  • Actuator management
  • Signal processing and prototyping
  • General electronics development

Important Notes

  • A compatible CH340 serial driver may be required for proper USB communication with the computer.
  • Do not exceed the maximum 40 mA current rating of an individual I/O pin.
  • Higher input voltage through the barrel jack can increase heat dissipation in the onboard voltage regulator.
  • The ATmega328 SMD controller is permanently mounted on the PCB and is not removable like a traditional DIP package.

  • 1 × USB Interface / Programming Cable

details.description:
Arduino Uno R3 High-Quality Edition

The Arduino Uno R3 High-Quality Edition is a reliable microcontroller development board based on the ATmega328. It is designed for electronics projects, robotics, automation, STEM education, prototyping, and embedded system development.

This board provides 14 digital input/output pins, including 6 PWM outputs, along with 6 analog input pins. It operates at 5V and features a 16 MHz clock speed for running Arduino programs and controlling connected electronic components.

The Arduino Uno R3 can be powered through USB or an external power supply. Its USB interface also allows convenient programming and serial communication with a computer. A USB programming cable is included with the product.

Technical Specifications

Specification Details
Model UNO Rev R3
Microcontroller ATmega328
Operating Voltage 5V
Recommended Input Voltage 7V - 12V
Input Voltage Limit 6V - 20V
Digital I/O Pins 14 (6 provide PWM output)
PWM Pins 6
Analog Input Pins 6
DC Current per I/O Pin 40 mA
DC Current for 3.3V Pin 50 mA
Clock Speed 16 MHz
Flash Memory 32 KB
SRAM 2 KB
EEPROM 1 KB
On-Board LEDs On/Off, L (Pin 13), TX, RX
Software Compatibility Arduino Software Compatible
Weight 28g without cable / 54g with cable
Shipment Dimensions 9 × 6 × 4 cm
Country of Origin China

Power

The Arduino Uno R3 can be powered through the USB connection or by an external power supply. The board automatically selects the appropriate power source.

  • USB Power: 5V
  • Recommended External Input: 7V - 12V
  • External Input Limit: 6V - 20V
  • Power Jack: 2.1mm center-positive plug
  • 3.3V Output: Maximum 50 mA
  • GND: Ground connection
  • VIN: External power input

For stable operation, an external supply of 7V to 12V is recommended. Supplying more than 12V may cause the onboard voltage regulator to overheat.

Memory

The ATmega328 microcontroller provides sufficient memory for a wide range of Arduino projects.

  • Flash Memory: 32 KB
  • SRAM: 2 KB
  • EEPROM: 1 KB
  • Bootloader: 0.5 KB of Flash is used by the bootloader

Input and Output

The Arduino Uno R3 features 14 digital I/O pins and 6 analog input pins, providing flexible connectivity for sensors, LEDs, switches, displays, motors, and other electronic components.

  • Digital I/O: 14 pins
  • PWM: Pins 3, 5, 6, 9, 10 and 11
  • Analog Inputs: A0 - A5
  • Digital Pin Current: Maximum 40 mA per I/O pin
  • Analog Resolution: 10-bit
  • SPI: Pins 10, 11, 12 and 13
  • Serial: Pins 0 (RX) and 1 (TX)
  • TWI/I2C: A4 (SDA) and A5 (SCL)

Communication

The Uno R3 supports several communication interfaces for connecting the board to computers, sensors, modules, displays, and other microcontrollers.

  • USB: Programming and serial communication
  • UART: TTL serial communication
  • I2C / TWI: Supported through the Wire library
  • SPI: Supported through the SPI library

Programming

The Arduino Uno R3 can be programmed using the Arduino software through the USB connection. The ATmega328 comes with a bootloader that allows new programs to be uploaded without requiring an external hardware programmer.

The board also provides an ICSP header for programming the microcontroller directly when required.

  • 14 digital input/output pins
  • 6 PWM outputs
  • 6 analog input pins
  • 16 MHz clock speed
  • USB connectivity
  • Power jack
  • ICSP header
  • Reset button
  • Built-in TX, RX and Pin 13 LEDs
  • USB overcurrent protection

Applications

  • STEM and educational projects
  • Electronics prototyping
  • Home automation projects
  • Sensor-based projects
  • Motor control projects
  • LED and display projects
  • Embedded system development
  • IoT and automation prototypes

  • 1 × Arduino Uno R3 High-Quality Edition
  • 1 × USB Programming Cable

The Arduino Uno R3 SMD CH340G is an affordable development board based on the ATmega328 SMD microcontroller. It uses the CH340G USB-to-UART interface for USB connectivity and programming, making it suitable for electronics development, robotics, STEM education, automation, sensor projects, and embedded prototyping.

Unlike the traditional DIP version, this board uses a Surface-Mount Device (SMD) version of the ATmega328. It provides the familiar Arduino Uno pin configuration with 14 digital I/O pins, including 6 PWM outputs, and 6 analog input pins.

The board operates at 5V and has a recommended external input voltage of 7V to 12V. It can be powered through either the DC power jack or USB.

EEPROM 1 KB
Flash Memory 32 KB (0.5 KB used by bootloader)
Power Supply Options DC Jack or USB
On-Board LEDs On/Off, L (Pin 13), TX, RX

  • CH340G USB-to-UART interface
  • 14 digital input/output pins
  • 6 PWM output pins
  • 6 analog input pins
  • 16 MHz clock speed
  • 32 KB Flash memory
  • 2 KB SRAM and 1 KB EEPROM
  • On-board Power, Pin 13, RX and TX LEDs
  • USB and DC Jack power options

Power

The Arduino Uno R3 SMD can be powered through the USB connection or external DC power jack. The recommended input voltage is 7V to 12V.

  • Operating Voltage: 5V
  • Recommended Input: 7V - 12V
  • Input Voltage Limit: 6V - 20V
  • Power Options: DC Jack or USB
  • 3.3V Pin Current: 50 mA

Avoid unnecessarily high input voltage through the barrel jack, as higher voltage increases heat dissipation in the onboard regulator.

Memory

The ATmega328 provides sufficient memory for Arduino-based electronics, robotics, automation, and embedded projects.

  • Flash Memory: 32 KB
  • Bootloader: 0.5 KB
  • SRAM: 2 KB
  • EEPROM: 1 KB

Input and Output

  • Digital I/O: 14 pins
  • PWM: 6 pins
  • Analog Inputs: 6 pins
  • Maximum I/O Current: 40 mA per pin

USB Interface & Programming

This version uses the CH340G USB-to-UART converter instead of the ATmega16U2 interface used on the standard Arduino Uno R3. It provides USB connectivity for programming and serial communication.

Depending on the operating system, a compatible CH340/CH341 driver may be required so that the board can be detected as a virtual COM port.

  • Embedded automation projects

  • Smart home relay control prototypes
  • Motor speed regulation
  • Actuator management
  • Signal processing and prototyping
  • General electronics development

Important Notes

  • A compatible CH340 serial driver may be required for proper USB communication with the computer.
  • Do not exceed the maximum 40 mA current rating of an individual I/O pin.
  • Higher input voltage through the barrel jack can increase heat dissipation in the onboard voltage regulator.
  • The ATmega328 SMD controller is permanently mounted on the PCB and is not removable like a traditional DIP package.

  • 1 × USB Interface / Programming Cable

সর্বোচ্চ কোমলতা এবং দীর্ঘস্থায়ী স্থায়িত্ব উভয়ের জন্যই তৈরি করা হয়েছে, আমাদের বহুমুখী হুডিটিতে ব্যক্তিগতকৃত কভারেজের জন্য একটি সামঞ্জস্যযোগ্য ড্রস্ট্রিং হুড এবং আপনার হাত উষ্ণ রাখতে বা প্রয়োজনীয় জিনিসপত্র সংরক্ষণের জন্য একটি প্রশস্ত ক্যাঙ্গারু পকেট রয়েছে। এর ক্লাসিক, আরামদায়ক ফিট চলাচলের সর্বোচ্চ স্বাধীনতা নিশ্চিত করে, যা এটিকে আপনার প্রিয় টি-শার্টের উপরে পরার জন্য বা একা পরার জন্য আদর্শ করে তোলে। আপনি বাড়িতে আরাম করুন, জিমে যান বা ছোটখাটো কাজের জন্য বাইরে যান, এই স্টাইলিশ এবং আরামদায়ক হুডিটি আপনার নিখুঁত সঙ্গী, যা সারা বছর পরিধানযোগ্যতা এবং নিরন্তর আকর্ষণ নিশ্চিত করে। আপনার সংগ্রহে এই অবশ্যই থাকা উচিত এমন সংযোজনটির সাথে ফ্যাশন এবং কার্যকারিতার নিখুঁত মিশ্রণটি অনুভব করুন।

সর্বোচ্চ কোমলতা এবং দীর্ঘস্থায়ী স্থায়িত্ব উভয়ের জন্যই তৈরি করা হয়েছে, আমাদের বহুমুখী হুডিটিতে ব্যক্তিগতকৃত কভারেজের জন্য একটি সামঞ্জস্যযোগ্য ড্রস্ট্রিং হুড এবং আপনার হাত উষ্ণ রাখতে বা প্রয়োজনীয় জিনিসপত্র সংরক্ষণের জন্য একটি প্রশস্ত ক্যাঙ্গারু পকেট রয়েছে। এর ক্লাসিক, আরামদায়ক ফিট চলাচলের সর্বোচ্চ স্বাধীনতা নিশ্চিত করে, যা এটিকে আপনার প্রিয় টি-শার্টের উপরে পরার জন্য বা একা পরার জন্য আদর্শ করে তোলে। আপনি বাড়িতে আরাম করুন, জিমে যান বা ছোটখাটো কাজের জন্য বাইরে যান, এই স্টাইলিশ এবং আরামদায়ক হুডিটি আপনার নিখুঁত সঙ্গী, যা সারা বছর পরিধানযোগ্যতা এবং নিরন্তর আকর্ষণ নিশ্চিত করে। আপনার সংগ্রহে এই অবশ্যই থাকা উচিত এমন সংযোজনটির সাথে ফ্যাশন এবং কার্যকারিতার নিখুঁত মিশ্রণটি অনুভব করুন।
